### ProfileAttribute

object: A profile attribute.
- `attributeId` (AttributeId, required)
- `index` (integer, required)
- `name` (string, required)
- `wallType` (boolean)
- `beamType` (boolean)
- `coluType` (boolean)
- `handrailType` (boolean)
- `otherGDLObjectType` (boolean)
- `useWith` (array of ProfileUseWith)
- `width` (number)
- `height` (number)
- `minimumWidth` (number)
- `minimumHeight` (number)
- `widthStretchable` (boolean)
- `heightStretchable` (boolean)
- `stretchZones` (ProfileStretchZones)
- `hasCoreSkin` (boolean)
- `profileModifiers` (array of ProfileModifier)
- `skins` (array of ProfileSkin): The profile's skins (hatches), each with its building material/surface/fill, contour and cut-end line settings, and per-edge line data.
- `openingReferenceLines` (array of ProfileOpeningReferenceLine): The profile's opening reference lines (Profile Editor, "Opening Reference"): doors and windows in a wall with this profile are placed by them instead of by the profile's bounding box. Empty when the profile has none.
- `nominalSize` (ProfileNominalSize): The positions of the profile's nominal width and height lines (Profile Editor), in the coordinates of skins[].outlineCoords. A profile without nominal size lines reports the bounds Archicad uses instead.
- `hotspots` (array of Coordinate2D): The hotspots of the profile (Profile Editor), in the coordinates of skins[].outlineCoords.

### ProfileOpeningReferenceLine

object: An opening reference line of a profile, in the coordinates GetProfiles reports in skins[].outlineCoords (x across the wall, y up). Openings are placed between the lines, at the heights where they cross the opening.
- `begin` (Coordinate2D, required): The start point of the line.
- `end` (Coordinate2D, required): The end point of the line.

### ProfileStretchZones

object: The stretch zones of a profile (Profile Manager > Modifiers: Horizontal Stretch and Vertical Stretch), in the coordinates of skins[].outlineCoords. A zone the profile does not have is omitted.
- `horizontal` (ProfileStretchZone): The horizontal stretch zone (width), an x range. Present only when the profile is widthStretchable.
- `vertical` (ProfileStretchZone): The vertical stretch zone (height), a y range. Present only when the profile is heightStretchable.

### ProfileStretchZone

object: One stretch zone of a profile: the range between min and max is the part of the profile that stretches.
- `min` (number, required): The lower limit of the zone (the left one for a horizontal zone, the bottom one for a vertical zone).
- `max` (number, required): The upper limit of the zone (the right one for a horizontal zone, the top one for a vertical zone). Must be greater than min.

### ProfileNominalSize

object: The nominal width and height lines of a profile (Profile Editor): the x of the left and right nominal width lines and the y of the bottom and top nominal height lines, in the coordinates of GetProfiles' skins[].outlineCoords. The nominal width is right - left, the nominal height top - bottom.
- `left` (number, required)
- `right` (number, required)
- `bottom` (number, required)
- `top` (number, required)

### ProfileAreaMethod

object: The component area method of a profile skin (Profile Manager): the line or circle the skin's area is projected onto. None: no projection shape. Line: the line from lineBegin to lineEnd. Circle: the circle with center and radius. Coordinates are those of GetProfiles' skins[].outlineCoords.
- `type` (string ("None", "Line", "Circle"), required)
- `lineBegin` (Coordinate2D): Start of the line. Needed for Line.
- `lineEnd` (Coordinate2D): End of the line. Needed for Line.
- `center` (Coordinate2D): Center of the circle. Needed for Circle.
- `radius` (number): Radius of the circle, greater than 0. Needed for Circle.

### ProfileModifier

object: An offset modifier of the profile (Profile Manager, Modifiers): it moves edges of the profile's skins by the distance its dimension measures between two anchors. Its value is a live geometric measurement matching what the Profile Editor's dimension shows.
- `modifierId` (string): Identifier of the modifier, stable for the lifetime of the profile. Pass it to CreateProfiles' renameProfileModifiers to rename the modifier.
- `name` (string): User-authored label, e.g. 'Largeur support'. Present only if the profile's author assigned one.
- `value` (number): Present only when the parameter's dimension anchors could be resolved to concrete positions.
- `edges` (array of ProfileModifierEdge): The edges the modifier moves.
- `begin` (ProfileModifierAnchor): The anchor the modifier's dimension starts at.
- `end` (ProfileModifierAnchor): The anchor the modifier's dimension ends at.
- `projectionAngle` (number): The direction, in radians from the x axis, the dimension is measured along. Present only when the dimension has one; otherwise it is measured along its nominal direction.

### ProfileModifierEdge

object: An edge of a profile skin that an offset modifier moves. Edge i of a skin runs from its outlineCoords[i] to outlineCoords[i + 1] (GetProfiles' skins[].outlineCoords, field skinOutlines); 0 and the last index are not edges of the drawn shape.
- `skinId` (string, required): The skin, from GetProfiles' skins[].skinId.
- `edgeIndex` (integer, required): The edge of the skin, the same position as in GetProfiles' skins[].edges.
- `direction` (string ("Left", "Right")): Which way Archicad moves the edge for a growing value, as it stores it. CreateProfiles works it out from the shape when it is omitted.

### ProfileModifierAnchor

object: One end of an offset modifier's dimension. Fixed: a point (position). Vertex: a vertex of a skin (skinId, vertexIndex: a position in GetProfiles' skins[].outlineCoords, 1 or more). Edge: an edge of a skin (skinId, edgeIndex, as in ProfileModifierEdge), measured perpendicular to it. The other types follow the profile's bounding box corners or stretch zone limits and need nothing else.
- `type` (string ("Fixed", "Vertex", "Edge", "BoundingBoxUpperLeft", "BoundingBoxUpperRight", "BoundingBoxLowerLeft", "BoundingBoxLowerRight", "StretchZoneLeft", "StretchZoneRight", "StretchZoneBottom", "StretchZoneTop", "Undefined"), required)
- `position` (Coordinate2D): The point of a Fixed anchor, in the coordinates of skins[].outlineCoords.
- `skinId` (string): The skin of a Vertex or Edge anchor, from GetProfiles' skins[].skinId.
- `vertexIndex` (integer): The vertex of a Vertex anchor: its position in the skin's outlineCoords.
- `edgeIndex` (integer): The edge of an Edge anchor: edge i runs from outlineCoords[i] to outlineCoords[i + 1].
- `positiveSideOnRight` (boolean): Edge anchor: whether the dimension grows to the right of the edge, seen from its start to its end. CreateProfiles sets it so the value grows as the edge moves away from the other anchor when it is omitted.

### ProfileSkin

object: One skin (hatch) of the profile's cross-section.
- `skinId` (string): Internal identifier of this skin, stable for the lifetime of the profile. Pass it back in CreateProfiles' skinOverrides to target this skin for modification.
- `buildingMaterialId` (AttributeIdArrayItem)
- `surfaceId` (AttributeIdArrayItem)
- `fillId` (AttributeIdArrayItem)
- `contourPen` (integer)
- `contourLineTypeId` (AttributeIdArrayItem)
- `isCore` (boolean)
- `isFinish` (boolean)
- `visibleCutEndLines` (boolean)
- `cutEndLinePen` (integer)
- `cutEndLineTypeId` (AttributeIdArrayItem)
- `areaMethod` (ProfileAreaMethod)
- `edges` (array of ProfileEdge)
- `outlineCoords` (array of Coordinate2D): The skin's outline polygon vertices, present only when the skinOutlines field is requested alongside skins.
- `outlineSubPolyEnds` (array of integer): Index (into outlineCoords) of the last vertex of each contour, for skins whose outline has holes or multiple contours.
- `outlineArcs` (array of object): Marks which consecutive outlineCoords pairs are connected by an arc instead of a straight edge.
  - `begIndex` (integer, required)
  - `endIndex` (integer, required)
  - `arcAngle` (number, required)

### ProfileEdge

object: One edge of a profile skin's outline.
- `surfaceFromBuildingMaterial` (boolean): Whether the edge takes the surface of the skin's building material. False when the edge has a custom surface (surfaceId).
- `surfaceId` (AttributeIdArrayItem): The custom surface of the edge (Profile Manager: Apply Custom Surface or Line Type to Profile Edge). Only when surfaceFromBuildingMaterial is false and a surface is set.
- `pen` (integer)
- `lineTypeId` (AttributeIdArrayItem)
- `isVisibleLine` (boolean)
- `isCutEndLine` (boolean)
- `isInnerLine` (boolean)

### ProfileEdgeOverride

object
- `edgeIndex` (integer, required)
- `pen` (integer)
- `isVisibleLine` (boolean)
- `isInnerLine` (boolean): Whether the edge is an inner line of the profile (GetProfiles' edges[].isInnerLine).
- `isCutEndLine` (boolean): Whether the edge is a cut end line of the profile (GetProfiles' edges[].isCutEndLine).
- `lineTypeId` (AttributeIdArrayItem)
- `buildingMaterialId` (AttributeIdArrayItem): Kept for compatibility: makes the edge take the surface of the skin's building material, like surfaceFromBuildingMaterial true. The building material itself is not stored on the edge.
- `surfaceId` (AttributeIdArrayItem): A custom surface for the edge (Profile Manager: Apply Custom Surface or Line Type to Profile Edge). Sets surfaceFromBuildingMaterial to false.
- `surfaceFromBuildingMaterial` (boolean): True: the edge takes the surface of the skin's building material, its custom surface is no longer used. False: the edge uses its custom surface (give surfaceId if it has none yet). Applied after buildingMaterialId and surfaceId.

### ProfileSkinContour

object
- `polygonCoordinates` (array of Coordinate2D, required): The 2D coordinates of this contour.
- `polygonArcs` (array of PolyArc): Optional arcs along this contour's edges. begIndex/endIndex are 0-based positions within this contour's own polygonCoordinates and must be the two ends of one edge (consecutive vertices, either direction); the closing edge is n-1 -> 0 (n-1 -> n is also accepted). An arc that is not on an edge is refused with an error.

### LineSymbolItemData

object
- `itemType` (string, required): Separator, CenterDot, CenterLine, Dot, RightAngle, Parallel, Line, Circle, or Arc.
- `centerOffset` (number): Vertical distance from the origin. Used for Separator, CenterDot, and CenterLine item types.
- `length` (number): Length of the item. Used for CenterLine, RightAngle, and Parallel item types.
- `begPos` (Coordinate2D): Beginning position. Used for Dot, RightAngle, Parallel, Line, Circle, and Arc item types.
- `endPos` (Coordinate2D): End position. Used for Line item type only.
- `radius` (number): Radius. Used for Circle and Arc item types.
- `beginAngle` (number): Beginning angle in radians, measured from the vertical axis. Used for Arc item type only.
- `endAngle` (number): End angle in radians, measured from the vertical axis. Used for Arc item type only.

### PenData

object
- `index` (integer, required): Index of the pen [1..255].
- `color` (ColorRGB)
- `width` (number): Thickness of the pen defined in paper millimeters.
- `description` (string): Textual description of the pen.

### ProfileSkinData

object: One new skin (hatch). Its shape is one or more closed polygon contours: the first is the outer boundary, any further ones are holes cut out of it - the same polygon+holes convention as e.g. CreateSlabs' polygonCoordinates/polygonArcs/holes, just expressed as a list of contours instead of a separate holes array.
- `contours` (array of ProfileSkinContour, required): Closed polygon contours forming this skin's cross-section, in the Profile's local coordinate system. Each contour is closed automatically - do not repeat its first vertex at the end.
- `buildingMaterialId` (AttributeIdArrayItem)
- `surfaceId` (AttributeIdArrayItem)
- `fillId` (AttributeIdArrayItem)
- `contourPen` (integer)
- `contourLineTypeId` (AttributeIdArrayItem)
- `isCore` (boolean)
- `isFinish` (boolean)
- `visibleCutEndLines` (boolean)
- `cutEndLinePen` (integer)
- `cutEndLineTypeId` (AttributeIdArrayItem)
- `areaMethod` (ProfileAreaMethod)
- `edgeOverrides` (array of ProfileEdgeOverride): Per-edge pen/visibility/line type, targeted by 0-based edge index. Edge indices follow the same order as this skin's contours/polygonCoordinates: the outer contour's edges first (one edge per vertex, wrapping around), then each hole's, in the order the contours were given. Verify exact indices for a created skin via a follow-up GetProfiles call's skins[].edges before relying on them.

### PolyArc

object: Representation of an arc segment of a two dimensional polygon/polyline.
- `begIndex` (integer, required): Node index of one end point of the arc.
- `endIndex` (integer, required): Node index of the other end point of the arc.
- `arcAngle` (number, required): Angle of the arc; it is positive, if the arc is on the right-hand side of the straight segment.

### Coordinate2D

object: 2D coordinate.
- `x` (number, required): X value of the coordinate.
- `y` (number, required): Y value of the coordinate.

### ColorRGB

object: RGB color.
- `red` (number, required): Red value between 0.0 and 1.0
- `green` (number, required): Green value between 0.0 and 1.0
- `blue` (number, required): Blue value between 0.0 and 1.0

### Texture

object: Texture parameters
- `name` (string, required): The filename of the texture in the library (without extension).
- `rotationAngle` (number): Rotation angle in radians.
- `xSize` (number): X size of the picture in model space, by default 1.
- `ySize` (number): Y size of the picture in model space, by default 1.
- `FillRectangle` (boolean): True, if fit the rectangle with the picture in a central position, using the natural aspect ratio of the picture.
- `FitPicture` (boolean): True, if fit the picture in the middle of the rectangle, using the natural aspect ratio of the picture.
- `mirrorX` (boolean): True, if the texture is mirrored in X direction.
- `mirrorY` (boolean): True, if the texture is mirrored in Y direction.
- `useAlphaChannel` (boolean): True, if the alpha channel of the texture is used.
- `alphaChannelChangesTransparency` (boolean): True, if the alpha channel of the texture changes the transparency.
- `alphaChannelChangesSurfaceColor` (boolean): True, if the alpha channel of the texture changes the surface color.
- `alphaChannelChangesAmbientColor` (boolean): True, if the alpha channel of the texture changes the ambient color.
- `alphaChannelChangesSpecularColor` (boolean): True, if the alpha channel of the texture changes the specular color.
- `alphaChannelChangesDiffuseColor` (boolean): True, if the alpha channel of the texture changes the diffuse color.

object: The details of an error.
- `code` (integer, required): The code of the error.
- `message` (string, required): The error message.

### DryRun

boolean: If true, the command makes all the checks of a real run and resolves the same targets, with the same errors, but changes nothing in the project and creates no undo step. The response is that of a real run with "dryRun": true added, and says for each target what the real run would do. Default is false.

object: The result of a dry run for a target that passed every check: a real run would delete it.
- `success` (boolean (true), required)

SuccessfulExecutionResult or WouldDeleteExecutionResult or FailedExecutionResult: The result of a deletion for one target. On a dry run a target that passed every check gets wouldDelete instead of being deleted.

### GraphicOverrideElementType

string ("Wall", "Column", "Beam", "Slab", "Roof", "Shell", "Stair", "Railing", "CurtainWall", "Opening", "Mesh", "Morph", ...): The tool an element was created with. Window, Door, Zone, Label, Object, Lamp and GridElement were checked on Archicad 27 and 29 against the override Archicad applies to each element; Skylight, CornerWindow, WallEnd and the MEP parts are recognized by Archicad but were not checked on elements. Sub-elements (curtain wall panels, stair treads, railing posts, ...) and groups are not offered by the criteria editor: a rule on CurtainWall, Stair or Railing applies to the whole element.

### GraphicOverrideCriterion

object: Structured conditions of a graphic override rule, turned into Archicad's criterion XML (an alternative to criterionXML). Give exactly one property (classificationSystem and libraryPartSubtype go next to the condition they belong to). 'and'/'or' combine other conditions, nested at most three levels like the rows of the criteria editor (see their description). GetGraphicOverrideRules returns this shape with includeCriterion. 'elementType' filters by the tool an element was created with; 'all3DTypes'/'all2DTypes' match every 3D or 2D element. The other properties are conditions of Archicad's criteria editor: classification, layer and Model View, Construction, Positioning, Plan and Section, Surfaces and Materials, ID and Categories, Geometry, custom properties, and fields of the Wall, Column, Beam, Slab, Roof, Shell, Object/Lamp, Door/Window, Opening, Curtain Wall and Stair tools. Their identifiers were captured from rules made in the criteria editor of Archicad 29; Archicad 27 keeps the generated rules as well. Not available: text content, the line pen of a dimension, hotlinked modules and Xrefs, and the MEP system (their stored format is not decoded yet).
- `and` (array of GraphicOverrideCriterion): Matches if all of the nested criteria match. Nesting follows the criteria editor's table, at most three levels: the top 'and' holds the rows, a row with several values is an 'or' (values joined with 'or') or an 'and' (joined with 'and'), and values joined with 'and' within an 'or' row are one more 'and'. A deeper 'and'/'or' is rejected.
- `or` (array of GraphicOverrideCriterion): Matches if any of the nested criteria match. As a row of the criteria editor's table: the values of one condition joined with 'or'. Nested at most three levels, see 'and'.
- `criterionXML` (string): One condition in Archicad's criterion XML: a <ClassGuid> followed by the condition's element, as GetGraphicOverrideRules returns a condition it does not decode. Written into the criterion unchanged.
- `elementType` (GraphicOverrideElementType): Matches elements created with this tool. 'AllTypes' matches elements of every type.
- `elementTypeNot` (GraphicOverrideElementType): Matches elements not created with this tool (the criteria editor's 'is not'). 'AllTypes' is not allowed here.
- `libraryPartSubtype` (object): Narrows elementType or elementTypeNot to a library part subtype of the tool, as the criteria editor stores it: the subtype's main and revision guid. GetGraphicOverrideRules returns it for the tools it decodes.
  - `mainGuid` (string, required)
  - `revGuid` (string, required)
- `classification` (string): Matches elements classified with this Classification System item ID (e.g. 'Slab'), or with any descendant of it in the classification tree (ArchiCAD's 'is in the branch of' operator - not a strict equality check).
- `classificationNot` (string): Matches elements NOT classified with this Classification System item ID and not with any descendant of it in the classification tree (ArchiCAD's 'is not in the branch of' operator - not a strict inequality check).
- `classificationSystem` (string): The classification system 'classification'/'classificationNot' refers to: its name as shown in the Classification Manager (e.g. 'Classification Archicad'), or its name and version as the criteria editor shows them (e.g. 'Classification Archicad - v 2.0'). Left out: the only classification system of the project that contains the item ID (the only system at all for classificationHasValue and classificationHasNoValue); an error when several do.

- `all2DTypes` (boolean): If true, matches every 2D drawing element type.

- `fontIs` (string): Matches elements whose font equals this font name (as GetDetailsOfElements reports it in fontName, with its script, e.g. 'Arial Western') exactly. Applies to 2D annotation (Text/Label) elements - unlike every other field in this schema, this one and 'textPen*' are NOT combined with a 3D-model-element anchor when used alone or together, since they don't apply to 3D model elements.
- `fontContains` (string): Matches elements whose font is one of a list containing this font name (as GetDetailsOfElements reports it in fontName, with its script, e.g. 'Arial Western') (ArchiCAD's 'contains' operator for a font field).
- `fontNotContains` (string): Matches elements whose font is not one of a list containing this font name (as GetDetailsOfElements reports it in fontName, with its script, e.g. 'Arial Western').

- `linePenNotContains` (integer): Matches elements whose line pen number is NOT this value (by plain pen number 1-255).
- `textPenIs` (integer): Matches elements whose text pen number equals this value (by plain pen number 1-255). Applies to 2D annotation elements - see 'fontIs' for the anchor-exemption note.
- `textPenContains` (integer): Matches elements whose text pen number is this value (ArchiCAD's 'contains' operator for a pen field, by plain pen number 1-255).
- `textPenNotContains` (integer): Matches elements whose text pen number is NOT this value (by plain pen number 1-255).
- `hatchContourPen` (integer): Matches elements whose hatch contour pen number equals this value (by plain pen number 1-255). Unlike 'linePenContains', ArchiCAD offers strict is/is-not here, not contains/does-not-contain.
- `hatchContourPenNot` (integer): Matches elements whose hatch contour pen number does not equal this value (by plain pen number 1-255).

- `profileStretchWidthLessOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile 'width stretch' modifier is less than or equal to this value.
- `profileStretchWidthGreaterOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile 'width stretch' modifier is greater than or equal to this value.
- `profileNominalHeight` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal height equals this value.
- `profileNominalHeightNot` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal height does not equal this value.
- `profileNominalHeightLessThan` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal height is less than this value.
- `profileNominalHeightGreaterThan` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal height is greater than this value.
- `profileNominalHeightLessOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal height is less than or equal to this value.
- `profileNominalHeightGreaterOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal height is greater than or equal to this value.
- `profileTotalHeight` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total height equals this value.
- `profileTotalHeightNot` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total height does not equal this value.
- `profileTotalHeightLessThan` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total height is less than this value.
- `profileTotalHeightGreaterThan` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total height is greater than this value.
- `profileTotalHeightLessOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total height is less than or equal to this value.
- `profileTotalHeightGreaterOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total height is greater than or equal to this value.
- `profileTotalWidth` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total width equals this value.
- `profileTotalWidthNot` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total width does not equal this value.
- `profileTotalWidthLessThan` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total width is less than this value.
- `profileTotalWidthGreaterThan` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total width is greater than this value.
- `profileTotalWidthLessOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total width is less than or equal to this value.
- `profileTotalWidthGreaterOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile total width is greater than or equal to this value.
- `profileNominalWidth` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal width equals this value.
- `profileNominalWidthNot` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal width does not equal this value.
- `profileNominalWidthLessThan` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal width is less than this value.
- `profileNominalWidthGreaterThan` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal width is greater than this value.
- `profileNominalWidthLessOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal width is less than or equal to this value.
- `profileNominalWidthGreaterOrEqual` (number): Matches elements whose Complex Profile nominal width is greater than or equal to this value.
- `profileParameter` (object): Matches elements by a custom Complex Profile modifier parameter, identified by its plain name as defined on that Complex Profile attribute (e.g. 'Debord tole') rather than a fixed field - use this for any profile modifier not covered by the profileStretchHeight/profileNominalWidth/... fields above. Provide 'name' and exactly one comparison operator.
  - `name` (string, required): The profile modifier parameter's name, exactly as defined on the Complex Profile attribute.
  - `equals` (number)
  - `notEquals` (number)
  - `lessThan` (number)
  - `greaterThan` (number)
  - `lessOrEqual` (number)
  - `greaterOrEqual` (number)
- `customPropertyBool` (object): Matches elements by a custom (user-defined) boolean property, identified by its plain name and the name of the property group it appears under (both exactly as shown in the Property Manager). Provide 'name', 'group', and exactly one of the operators below. The 6 'has.../is...' operators are available on every custom property type, not just boolean ones.
  - `name` (string, required): The custom property's name, exactly as defined.
  - `group` (string, required): The custom property group's name, exactly as defined (e.g. 'Generalites').
  - `equals` (boolean): Matches if the property's value equals this.
  - `hasDefaultValue` (boolean): If true, matches elements where this property currently has its default value.
  - `hasCustomValue` (boolean): If true, matches elements where this property has a custom (overridden, non-default) value.
  - `isAvailable` (boolean): If true, matches elements where this property is available.
  - `isNotAvailable` (boolean): If true, matches elements where this property is not available.
  - `isUndefined` (boolean): If true, matches elements where this property is undefined.
  - `isNotUndefined` (boolean): If true, matches elements where this property is not undefined.
- `customPropertyString` (object): Matches elements by a custom (user-defined) text or option-set property, identified by its plain name and the name of the property group it appears under. Provide 'name', 'group', and exactly one operator. The value is written in the form the criteria editor uses for the property: wrapped for a free text property, bare for a single choice option set, as a list of one option for a multiple choice option set, which takes equals only. contains, notContains, startsWith and endsWith are available for a free text property only.
  - `name` (string, required): The custom property's name, exactly as defined.
  - `group` (string, required): The custom property group's name, exactly as defined.
  - `equals` (string): Matches if the property's value equals this string exactly.
  - `notEquals` (string): Matches if the property's value does not equal this string.
  - `contains` (string): Matches if the property's value contains this text (free text properties only).
  - `notContains` (string): Matches if the property's value does not contain this text (free text properties only).
  - `startsWith` (string): Matches if the property's value starts with this text (free text properties only).
  - `endsWith` (string): Matches if the property's value ends with this text (free text properties only).
  - `hasDefaultValue` (boolean)
  - `hasCustomValue` (boolean)
  - `isAvailable` (boolean)
  - `isNotAvailable` (boolean)
  - `isUndefined` (boolean)
  - `isNotUndefined` (boolean)
- `customPropertyNumber` (object): Matches elements by a custom (user-defined) numeric property, identified by its plain name and the name of the property group it appears under. Provide 'name', 'group', and exactly one operator.
  - `name` (string, required): The custom property's name, exactly as defined.
  - `group` (string, required): The custom property group's name, exactly as defined.
  - `equals` (number)
  - `notEquals` (number)
  - `lessThan` (number)
  - `greaterThan` (number)
  - `lessOrEqual` (number)
  - `greaterOrEqual` (number)
  - `hasDefaultValue` (boolean)
  - `hasCustomValue` (boolean)
  - `isAvailable` (boolean)
  - `isNotAvailable` (boolean)
  - `isUndefined` (boolean)
  - `isNotUndefined` (boolean)
- `customPropertyInteger` (object): Matches elements by a custom (user-defined) integer property, identified by its plain name and the name of the property group it appears under. Provide 'name', 'group', and exactly one operator.
  - `name` (string, required): The custom property's name, exactly as defined.
  - `group` (string, required): The custom property group's name, exactly as defined.
  - `equals` (integer)
  - `notEquals` (integer)
  - `lessThan` (integer)
  - `greaterThan` (integer)
  - `lessOrEqual` (integer)
  - `greaterOrEqual` (integer)
  - `hasDefaultValue` (boolean)
  - `hasCustomValue` (boolean)
  - `isAvailable` (boolean)
  - `isNotAvailable` (boolean)
  - `isUndefined` (boolean)
  - `isNotUndefined` (boolean)

### GraphicOverrideCombinationIdOrError

GraphicOverrideCombinationIdArrayItem or ErrorItem: A graphic override combination identifier or an error.

### GraphicOverrideFillTypes

object: The fill types an override applies to.
- `cutFill` (boolean, required): Applies to cut fills.
- `coverFill` (boolean, required): Applies to cover fills.
- `draftingFill` (boolean, required): Applies to drafting fills.

### GraphicOverrideSurfaceTypes

object: The surface types an override applies to.
- `cutSurface` (boolean, required): Applies to cut surfaces.
- `uncutSurface` (boolean, required): Applies to uncut surfaces.

### GraphicOverrideStyle

object: What a graphic override rule overrides and how. A field that is left out is not overridden.
- `lineType` (AttributeId): The line type that replaces the line type of lines.
- `lineMarkerTextPen` (integer): The pen index that replaces the pen of lines, markers and texts.
- `fillType` (AttributeId): The fill type that replaces the fill type of fills.
- `fillTypeAppliesTo` (GraphicOverrideFillTypes): The fills the fill type override applies to. Left out: all fills.
- `fillForegroundPen` (integer): The pen index that replaces the foreground pen of fills.
- `fillForegroundPenAppliesTo` (GraphicOverrideFillTypes): The fills the foreground pen override applies to. Left out: all fills.
- `fillBackgroundPen` (integer): The pen index that replaces the background pen of fills. Use either this or fillBackgroundColor.
- `fillBackgroundColor` (ColorRGB): The color that replaces the background pen of fills. Use either this or fillBackgroundPen.
- `fillBackgroundPenAppliesTo` (GraphicOverrideFillTypes): The fills the background pen override applies to. Left out: all fills.
- `surface` (AttributeId): The surface that replaces the surface of elements. Use either this or surfaceColor.
- `surfaceColor` (ColorRGB): The color that replaces the surface of elements. Use either this or surface.
- `surfaceAppliesTo` (GraphicOverrideSurfaceTypes): The surfaces the surface override applies to. Left out: all surfaces.
- `showSkinSeparators` (boolean): Show the skin separator lines.
- `overridePenColorAndThickness` (boolean): Override the pen color and thickness.
- `hiddenContours` (GraphicOverrideSurfaceTypes): The contours to hide when overrideContours is true.
- `overrideContours` (boolean): Override the contour visibility.

### GraphicOverrideRule

object: A graphic override rule with its rule group, criterion and style.
- `graphicOverrideRuleId` (GraphicOverrideRuleId, required)
- `name` (string, required)
- `ruleGroupName` (string): The name of the rule group the rule belongs to.
- `criterionXML` (string, required): The criterion of the rule, in the XML format Archicad saves override rules in. Change its values and pass it to CreateGraphicOverrideRules or ModifyGraphicOverrideRules to make similar rules.
- `criterion` (GraphicOverrideCriterion): The criterion as structured conditions, returned with includeCriterion. It can be passed to CreateGraphicOverrideRules or ModifyGraphicOverrideRules as it is. The top 'and' holds the rows of the criteria editor's table; a row with several values is an 'or' or 'and' of them, and values joined with 'and' within an 'or' row are one more 'and'. A condition that is not decoded yet is a {"criterionXML": ...} leaf, written back unchanged. Left out when criterionXML is not in the format Archicad keeps rules in.
- `style` (GraphicOverrideStyle, required)

### GraphicOverrideRuleOrError

GraphicOverrideRule or ErrorItem: A graphic override rule or an error.

### AttributeCreationMethod

string ("AddOn", "Merge", "Paste", "New", "Import", "Explode", "Duplicate", "Hotlink", "XRef", "Library", "LibraryMaster", "Unspecified"): The creation method or workflow: AddOn (created by an Add-On), Merge (merging files), Paste (pasting from another file), New (created by the user through the UI), Import (an attribute file, IFC, DWG/DXF or another supported format), Explode (exploding a PDF or DWG), Duplicate (duplicating an attribute), Hotlink (a hotlinked file), XRef (a file attached in the Xref manager), Library (a library part), LibraryMaster (generated from GDL) or Unspecified.

### GraphicOverrideRuleReference

object
- `name` (string, required): The name of the rule. Rule names are unique within the project.
- `ruleGroupName` (string): The name of the rule group to search the rule in. Left out: every rule group is searched.

### GraphicOverrideRuleMove

object
- `graphicOverrideRuleId` (GraphicOverrideRuleId, required)
- `ruleGroupName` (string, required): The rule group the rule is moved to; it can be the rule's own group to change its place there. Created when no rule group has this name.
- `beforeGraphicOverrideRuleId` (GraphicOverrideRuleId): The rule of the target group the moved rule is put in front of. Left out: the rule becomes the last of the group.

### AttributeFolderRename

object
- `attributeType` (AttributeType, required)
- `path` (array of string, required): The names of the folders from the root folder down to the folder to rename, the root folder itself not included.
- `newName` (string, required): The new name of the folder.

### GraphicOverrideRuleGroupRename

object
- `name` (string, required): The current name of the rule group.
- `newName` (string, required): The new name of the rule group. It must not be empty or used by another rule group.

### ProjectAttributes

object
- `attributesByType` (array of ProjectAttributesByType or ErrorItem, required): One item per requested attribute type, in the order of attributeTypes.

### FontDetails

object
- `fontIndex` (integer, required): Index of the font (from 1), as Text and Label fields reference it in fontIndex.
- `fontName` (string, required): Name of the font as Archicad carries it.

### ProjectAttributesByType

object
- `attributeType` (AttributeType, required)
- `attributes` (AttributeHeaders, required)
